patch_description: The current move screen uses deterministic shortest-path tie-breakings as its only routing proxy. Add an equal-split shortest-path peak as an independent signal, computing it alongside the tie-break loads while reusing each destination’s reverse-BFS distances. Rank the shortlisted moves separately by energy, tie-robust peak, and equal-split peak, then combine those ranks for part of the batch. This makes routing estimates less dependent on one path-selection convention without turning either proxy into a hard filter, preserving energy guidance and exploration.
